title: Resend returns 409 invalid_idempotent_request when a retry reuses the key
symptoms: 400 invalid_idempotency_key for keys longer than 256 characters
cause: An Idempotency-Key is bound to the exact payload for 24 hours, so a retry that rebuilds the body differently, such as a new timestamp in the HTML, is refused. A second request while the first is still running gets a concurrency 409.
fix: Derive the key from a stable event id, build the payload deterministically, retry concurrent 409s after a pause, and keep keys under 256 characters.
affected: Resend API send and batch endpoints, keys kept 24 hours, as of 2026-10
